summary: Checked that the official LIGHT-mode module logos replace the text logos, on the website and the mobile web preview. All checks pass. Website light theme: the bMART/bFOOD/bSHOP/bSEND tabs show /logos/v2/b*-light.png with the right alt text, and every image loads (naturalWidth 900). The images and their parents have transparent backgrounds; only the active tab has its normal white tab background. bAUTO/bIMMO keep the text logo with badge-on-light.png. /send shows an extra bsend-light wordmark. On /food and /shop the active tab shows the light logo; no other module-logo header was found there. Dark theme goes back to b*-dark.png. Mobile preview (390x844), opened as a guest and moved through in-app navigation: Profil > Apparence > Mode clair gives app-root-light. Explorer searches for 'lait' and 'burger' show brand-logo-mart/food/shop/express with *-light assets. The module switcher shows all 4 light image logos plus brand-text-auto/immo with badge-on-light. After switching back to Mode sombre the switcher shows *-dark assets and dark badges. The Panier screen is empty for a guest, so no BrandName shows there; it could not be checked with items. All light PNGs (web public/logos/v2 and mobile assets/images/brand) are RGBA with a transparent corner pixel, so no white box.
critical_code_review_comments: BakedLogo.jsx: the MODULE_LOGO comment still says 'Official dark-mode PNGs'. It should mention light too (cosmetic).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Light/dark module logo swap verified on web (tabs, /send, /food, /shop) and mobile preview (Explorer lait/burger, switcher). Mobile: tap Passer twice, then welcome-guest; appearance via tab-profile > profile-item-appearance > appearance-option-light/dark. Cart branding not verified with items in the cart (guest cart is empty).
